title: Ammonia-Hydrogen Phase Equilibria in Planetary Envelopes from First-Principles-Based Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.27136v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ammonia and hydrogen are major constituents of planets within and beyond the solar system, yet how they interact in planetary envelopes is poorly known. We perform large-scale two-phase coexistence simulations of the ammonia-hydrogen system from 500 to 4000 K and 0.1 to 100 GPa, driven by machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory calculations. From these we map the compositions of coexisting hydrogen-rich and ammonia-rich phases, and the critical curve that separates conditions of complete miscibility from those of phase separation. The critical temperature increases with pressure, from 500 K at 0.1 GPa to 2000 K near 30 GPa, and we find no phase separation at 3000 and 4000 K up to 100 GPa. The slope of the critical curve decreases substantially between 0.3 and 30 GPa, and the curve nearly flattens above about 30 GPa and 2000 K, where molecules begin to give way to atomic species. translated_title: 基于第一性原理的机器学习分子动力学研究行星包层中的氨-氢相平衡
translated_abstract: 氨和氢是太阳系内外行星的主要组成成分，但它们在行星包层中如何相互作用却鲜为人知。我们基于密度泛函理论计算训练的机器学习原子间势，在500至4000 K、0.1至100 GPa的温压范围内，对氨-氢体系进行了大规模的两相共存模拟。由此我们绘制了共存的富氢相与富氨相的成分，以及区分完全混溶条件与相分离条件的临界曲线。临界温度随压力升高而上升，从0.1 GPa下的500 K增至约30 GPa附近的2000 K；我们发现在3000 K和4000 K时，直到100 GPa均未发生相分离。临界曲线的斜率在0.3至30 GPa之间显著减小，并在约30 GPa和2000 K以上几乎变得平坦，此时分子开始让位于原子物种。共存曲线（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究利用基于密度泛函理论训练的机器学习原子间势进行大规模两相共存模拟，绘制了行星包层温压条件下氨-氢体系的相平衡图，发现临界温度随压力从500 K升至2000 K并在约30 GPa、2000 K以上趋于平坦，对应分子开始解离为原子。
en_tdlr: Using machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on first-principles calculations, this work maps ammonia-hydrogen phase equilibria under planetary envelope conditions, showing the critical temperature rises from 500 K to 2000 K with pressure and nearly flattens above about 30 GPa and 2000 K, where molecules begin to dissociate into atomic species.
